caseName: Home for Destitute Children v. Peter Bent Brigham Hospital
caseNameFull: The Home for Destitute Children v. The Peter Bent Brigham Hospital, Trustees, etc.
disposition: Motion to dismiss or affirm submitted March 6, 1911.
summary: Appeal from the Circuit Court of the United States for the District of Massachusetts.
attorneys: Mr. Charles A. Snow and Mr. Joseph H. Knight for the appellants., Mr. J. L. Thorndike for the appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Farrell v. O’Brien, 199 U. S. 100; Kaufman v. Smith, 216 U. S. 610.
